# package-lock.json

[Exact copy](../original/package-lock.json)

Line numbers refer to the original file, before teaching comments.

### Line 1

```text
{
```

JSON structural delimiter at indentation 0; it opens or closes the surrounding lockfile object/array.

### Line 2

```text
  "name": "timekeeper-live-fork",
```

At the lockfile root, records the project name timekeeper-live-fork so npm can match this lock to package.json.

### Line 3

```text
  "lockfileVersion": 3,
```

At the lockfile root, selects lockfile format version 3, the npm representation used for the packages map.

### Line 4

```text
  "requires": true,
```

At the lockfile root, true means package dependency requirements are included and must be honored.

### Line 5

```text
  "packages": {
```

Opens the top-level packages map; each key below identifies a physical package installation path.

### Line 6

```text
    "": {
```

Opens the root package record at packages[""]; this record describes the current project rather than a node_modules dependency.

### Line 7

```text
      "name": "timekeeper-live-fork",
```

Inside packages[""], records the project name timekeeper-live-fork.

### Line 8

```text
      "devDependencies": {
```

Inside the root package record, opens its devDependencies map.
